page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg6.6xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by a dedicated Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at 3.1 GHz. It features 24 physical cores and 24 vCPUs with a 1.0 thread-per-core configuration. The instance is equipped with 96.0 GB of RAM, providing 4.0 GB of memory per core. It does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, relying on network-attached storage and delivering a baseline network bandwidth of 8 Gbps.

Benchmark data places this instance in the average performance tier across multiple tests. It achieves a stress-ng single-core CPU score of 1438.39 and a multi-core score of 23015.19. Memory bandwidth tests show read-only speeds of 1282.13 GB/sec for small cached blocks and 109.43 GB/sec for large uncached blocks, alongside a write speed of 48.03 GB/sec. For specialized tasks, the server records a Geekbench software compilation score of 19039.0 and a ray tracing score of 18402.0. In database operations, it processes 22.14 million Redis SET operations per second and achieves a PassMark database score of 8647.45.

From a resource density perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation and balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio offer stable compute performance without the overhead of hyperthreading. However, the lack of local storage and GPU hardware limits its utility for heavy storage-bound workloads or large-scale deep learning. The instance is suited for general-purpose workloads, software compilation, web serving, and moderate database operations.
